plain_text:
Prequel/spinoff adventure series centered on Harry Lime before his death in The Third Man. The frozen GRH container has all 52 numbered broadcasts plus two OTRR reference tracks; local station schedules and sponsors could vary because the series was transcribed for syndication.

GRH documents the program through 52-program syndicated run (August 3, 1951 to July 25, 1952).

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Anton Karas (performer on 52 recordings and zither on 52 recordings), Harry Alan Towers (producer on 52 recordings and performer on 1 recording), Orson Welles (performer on 52 recordings and writer on 3 recordings), Tig Roe (director on 51 recordings), Betty McDowell (performer on 1 recording), Graham Greene (creator on 1 recording), and Robert Rieti (performer on 1 recording).

The program is also connected in the archive to WRVR-FM (aircheck from station).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include confidence schemes and swindles, international travel and cosmopolitan settings, art, jewels and valuable objects, romance and seduction, murder and homicide, and blackmail and coercion.
